status: planning scenario only; no randomized experiment was run

design.question: Does moving a recommendation into rank 1 change its click probability, holding the candidate item constant?
design.eligible_population: Recommendation slates with a stable candidate set and no policy or safety exclusions.
design.randomization_unit: User, to keep assignment stable across repeated slates and reduce cross-arm contamination.
design.treatment: Swap rank 1 with one uniformly selected item from ranks 2–10; keep the candidate set unchanged.
design.primary_metric: Click-through rate of the preselected moved item within a prespecified attribution window.
guardrails: Slate-level useful engagement (for example, article opens followed by meaningful read depth).
Hide/report or quick-return rate, where available.
Exposure concentration and category/creator/format coverage, where those labels exist.
design.analysis: Intention-to-treat comparison with user-clustered uncertainty; report absolute and relative effects with confidence intervals.

power_scenarios.baseline_anchor: Observed ranks 2–10 CTR from the bounded observational sample; used only to illustrate planning scale.
power_scenarios.warning: Per-arm counts are independent-impression approximations. Final design must account for user clustering, eligibility, attrition, multiple guardrails, and the actual live baseline.
